scope: Proposition 6.6 (Strict improvement of the principal tensors) of the manuscript “Determination of a metric and a unitary connection from one boundary patch” (preprints/Determination-of-a-metric-and-a-unitary-connection-from-one-boundary-patch-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 365 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8e1bdd3a90672348), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With the fixed choices in Lemma 6.3, there are constants C and ρ0 > 0, uniform for sufficiently small λ, such that (6.4) implies H8(y) ≤ Crδ(y)3/2 if y ∈ K and rδ(y) < ρ0. (6.20) On the same set, the derivatives of D through order nine are bounded by Cr 3/2 δ .
